# Structured logging for the scheduler

## Summary

The scheduler's logs become JSON lines with a fixed set of keys, so operators can filter by job and node without regular expressions.

## Schema

Every line has `ts`, `level`, `job_id`, `node` and `msg`. Optional keys are `attempt` and `error`. We call this set the **core schema**; components may add keys under an `x_` prefix only.
section_request: Write the next section, on migrating existing log consumers.
strong:
## Migration

For one release the scheduler writes both formats: the existing text line and a core-schema JSON line to a second file. Consumers that grep text logs keep working; dashboards switch to the JSON file and filter on `job_id` and `node`. After that release the text format is removed. Components that already emit extra fields move them under `x_` names during the dual-write release.

## Migration

The scheduler currently writes unstructured text logs. This proposal changes them to JSON so that operators can filter more easily. Each log entry will contain a timestamp, a severity, the job, the machine and a message. For one release the scheduler writes both formats to separate files, after which the text format is removed. Extra fields from components should be renamed somehow.
